name: TEK receptor tyrosine kinase
pathways: positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction
positive regulation of Rac protein signal transduction

function.text: TEK encodes angiopoietin-1 receptor. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of Rac protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to TEK-related primary glaucoma (autosomal dominant); multiple cutaneous and mucosal venous malformations (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
